newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.37 pct - Fipe.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fipe inflation at 0.37 pct - Fipe.

text.p: Brazil's inflation as measured by the Economic Research Institute (Fipe) was 0.37 percent in the Sept 24-Oct 23 period, up from 0.27 percent in the previous four week period, a Fipe official said.
Juarez Rizzieri, president of Fipe, said an increase in food prices, especially meat and beans, helped to accelerate the price index, which measures costs in the city of Sao Paulo.
Food prices rose 0.51 percent in the period.
Rizzieri said he expected the October Fipe index to end around 0.5 percent.
He gave the following breakdown of the Fipe weighted index for September.
- Food 0.51 pct rise in the period
The Fipe index is calculated by the University of Sao Paulo, which releases inflation figures at weekly intervals.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
